hook: The Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory is falling toward Earth after 21 years.

sections.voiceover: The Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory is falling toward Earth after 21 years.
sections.visual_cue: CGI animation of the satellite orbiting Earth.
b_roll: Public domain footage of Earth from space

sections.voiceover: NASA concluded this science mission as the spacecraft dips below 171 miles of altitude. A commercial rescue attempt to reboost the telescope recently failed to stabilize it. How low can it go?
b_roll: NASA animation of satellite orbital decay

sections.voiceover: Except the telescope performed its final observation only days ago, on October 20, 2026.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of telescope components in space.
b_roll: NASA public domain image of Swift observatory

sections.voiceover: NASA officially shut down the spacecraft as its orbit continues to decay. This mission launched in November 2004, and now faces imminent atmospheric reentry. Gravity will soon reclaim this piece of history.
It remains only 171 miles above our home planet today.
